content: अभिधानम् .²1 Telling, mentioning, speaking, naming, denotation; एतावतामर्थानामिदमभिधानम् <ls>Nir.</ls>; गोशब्दस्य वाहीकार्थाभिधानम् <ls>S. D.</ls> .²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Asserting or predicating something of another, as the subject of an assertion, (which then can be put in the <ab>nom.</ab> case only); predication, assertion; see <ls>P. II. 3. 2. Sk.</ls> .²3 A name, appellation, title, designation; अभिधानं तु पश्चात्तस्याहमश्रौषम् <ls>K. 32</ls>; तवाभिधानाद् व्यथते नताननः <ls>Ki. 1. 24</ls>; (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) called, named; ऋणाभिधानाद् बन्धनात् <ls>R. 3. 20</ls>. .²4 An expression, word. .²5 Speech, discourse महत्तमानामभिधानयोगः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 18. 18</ls>. .²6 A dictionary, vocabulary (of words), lexicon (in these last 4 senses said to be also {%m.%}) .²7 A song, षट्पादतन्त्रीमधुराभिधानम् <ls>Rām. 4. 28. 36</ls>.
